title: The Princess Bride
author: William Goldman
summary: Presented as an abridgement of an old classic by an author who pretends to be only the editor, this is a tale of a farm boy and the beautiful girl he loves. They are separated by pirates, a prince and a quest for revenge.
readIf: you want a witty, affectionate adventure that parodies fairy tales while still being moving.
skipIf: you want a serious epic, or you would rather not have the narrator interrupt the story with asides.

pairings.reason: Another fairy tale for adults with a lightly mocking voice and a love story at its heart.
The swashbuckling classic that this book lovingly echoes, with duels and friendship.
Another very funny, quotable fantasy that mixes jokes with real affection for its characters.
